interpretation: All three GPU lanes are qualified in one public release; every claim binds an exact package, profile, and receipt.

Each lane runs its own best measured configuration rather than one shared configuration: the RTX 5090 context cache is sized so sibling forks of a stored template keep the shared base anchor (4/4 at 57.9K and 67.7K), the RTX 4090 prefill chunk moves to 2,048 (102,060-token session 68.0 s vs 84.9 s), and the RTX 3090 serves 131,072 tokens with exact retrieval at 130,048.
After a process restart the RTX 5090's first sibling fork of a restored template re-prefills once before its siblings run hot; restored sessions carry the endpoint, not the base anchor.
The composed external-installation acceptance reran the runtime-side steps and added native public-URL install acceptances on both Windows lanes.
Raw prompts, model outputs, private host identifiers, and raw request logs are excluded.
